Perfect! All tests are passing now. 

**The bug:** The `isExpired` function was using `<` instead of `<=`, which allowed tokens to remain valid at the exact moment of expiration. According to the spec ("A token is considered expired the moment `exp` is reached"), tokens should be expired when `exp <= nowSeconds`.

**The fix:** Changed line 7 from `return token.exp < nowSeconds;` to `return token.exp <= nowSeconds;`

This ensures expired tokens are properly rejected at the boundary condition, preventing them from slipping through.
